headlines.title: Watch: Videos capture the moment a 7.4-magnitude earthquake strikes Colombia
headlines.description: Watch videos captured from Colombia as a 7.4-magnitude earthquake struck the country. Casualties have been reported with many still missing amid the collapsed buildings and debris.

headlines.title: Trump signs executive order on vaccines
headlines.description: Watch live coverage as President Trump signs an executive order on vaccine research.

headlines.title: RFK Jr. wants to fix loophole that allows additives into food. Critics say it doesn’t go far enough.
headlines.description: The Trump administration said it’s taking first steps in strengthening rules over ingredients food companies have long added to their products with minimal oversight.

headlines.title: Trump Says US is ‘Only Semi-Negotiating’ With Iran
headlines.description: Oil prices jumped higher after Iran issued a long list of demands to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The United States announced more sanctions against Iran as questions loom over negotiations. NBC’s Keir Simmons reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Tupac Murder Trial Set to Begin, Nearly 30 Years After Shooting
headlines.description: The man accused of planning the murder of Tupac Shakur is set to stand trial as prosecutors look to prove Duane "Keefe D" Davis orchestrated the drive-by shooting that killed the hip-hop legend nearly 30 years ago. Davis has spent years talking about his involvement in the case, saying he was inside the Cadillac with the gunman when shots were fired from the backseat near the Las Vegas strip. NBC’s Chloe Melas reports and senior legal correspondent Laura Jarrett joins TODAY with analysis.

headlines.title: Woman and Baby Die After Boat Capsized in New York Harbor
headlines.description: New York City police are on the scene of a tragic boating accident where a woman and a young child were killed near the Statue of Liberty. The NYPD says they got a call about an overturned boat and when crews arrived, they found 12 people had already been rescued from the water but a 27-year-old woman and five-month-old little girl did not survive. WNBC’s Jessica Cunnington reports for Sunday TODAY.

headlines.title: Ben Jones, Cooter on ‘The Dukes of Hazzard’ and former congressman, dies at 84
headlines.description: Ben Jones, the man known as both Cooter from “The Dukes of Hazzard” television series and a former U.S. congressman from Georgia, died Sunday.

headlines.title: Centuries-old Roman shipwreck discovered off the coast Italy
headlines.description: Divers discovered a centuries-old Roman shipwreck about three miles off the coast of Sicily after a tip from the public. The site, believed to be dated between the second and first centuries B.C., contains hundreds of clay jugs and two lead anchor stocks.

headlines.title: Jake Whisenant, record-setting speed climber, dies at 30 in climbing accident
headlines.description: Jake Whisenant, a climber known for setting speed records in Yosemite National Park, has died in a climbing accident in California.

headlines.title: Tommy John, ex-Yankees pitcher and namesake of career-saving surgery, says goodbye
headlines.description: Baseball icon Tommy John announced his departure from public life, thanking the late doctor who innovated the surgery that bears the Yankees lefty’s name.

headlines.title: Dozens killed after powerful earthquake strikes Colombia and Ecuador
headlines.description: The USGS reported a 7.4-magnitude, deep earthquake with the epicenter in San José del Palmar, about 250 miles west of the capital, Bogotá.
